meta.name: muapi-brand-kit
meta.description: Generate a cohesive brand visual kit — logo concept, color palette moodboard, and typography pairing suggestions.

copy.tagline: 生成品牌视觉套件，包含标志、配色和字体方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速创建品牌视觉方案
copy.tagline_en: Generate a cohesive brand visual kit with logo, color palette, and typography
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly create a brand visual kit

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: Claude 会根据品牌名称、行业和个性，生成一套视觉方案，包括两个 Logo 概念、一个配色情绪板、一个品牌纹理，以及颜色和字体搭配建议。
howto.when: 当用户提到“品牌设计”、“Logo”、“视觉识别”等关键词，或要求为某个品牌创建视觉方案时触发。

say.text: 帮我为一家可持续时尚品牌设计视觉方案。
给一个叫“绿野仙踪”的有机茶品牌做 Logo 和配色。
say.note: Claude 会生成两个 Logo 概念和配色情绪板。

say.text: 为我的咖啡店品牌设计一套视觉识别系统。
say.note: Claude 会生成 Logo、配色、纹理和字体建议。

howto.what_en: Claude generates a cohesive brand visual kit including two logo concepts, a color palette moodboard, a brand pattern, and typography pairing suggestions based on brand name, industry, and personality.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions keywords like 'brand kit', 'brand identity', 'logo', 'branding', or asks to create a visual identity for a brand.

say_en.text: Design a visual kit for a sustainable fashion brand.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for inputs and generate the full set of assets.

say_en.text: Create a logo and color palette for an organic tea brand called 'Green Wonderland'.
say_en.note: Claude will generate two logo concepts and a moodboard.

say_en.text: Build a brand identity for my coffee shop.
say_en.note: Claude will generate logos, colors, pattern, and typography.
